objective: Extend the existing Curie fitting program to report fit quality for a noisy intensity series.
behavior: Use statistics.linear_regression with x=1/T and y=integrated intensity. Return coefficient_au_K, background_au, and rmse_au. No weighting. Include arrays predicted_au and residual_au in input row order (residual = measured minus predicted). Also return r_squared, the unweighted coefficient of determination computed as 1 - RSS/TSS for nonconstant intensities. Document constant-intensity handling.
review: Assess model suitability, normalization, saturation and the comparability of integrated intensities across temperatures.
